description: Defines an immutable command object for creating or updating document details within the Fineract infrastructure, including fields for document metadata and methods to access or modify certain properties.

classes.name: DocumentCommand
classes.description: An immutable command object for handling create or update operations for document metadata, including identifiers, descriptive fields, file information, and modification tracking.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the document.

methods.name: getParentEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of parent entity associated with the document.

methods.name: getParentEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the parent entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the document.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the document.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the document file.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the document.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the document.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the storage location of the document.

methods.name: getModifiedParameters
methods.description: Returns the set of parameters that have been modified.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the document.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the document.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the document.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the storage location of the document.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type identifier.

methods.name: setStorageType
methods.description: Sets the storage type identifier.

methods.name: isNameChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'name' parameter has been modified.

methods.name: isFileNameChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'fileName' parameter has been modified.

methods.name: isSizeChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'size' parameter has been modified.

methods.name: isFileTypeChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'type' parameter has been modified.

methods.name: isDescriptionChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'description' parameter has been modified.

methods.name: isLocationChanged
methods.description: Checks if the 'location' parameter has been modified.
